title: Watercolor 128 Red Cedar Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor Community guidelines the maximum number of wristbands this home is allotted is 12 bands to access WaterColor amenities and community pools- Located in the beautiful Camp community of WaterColor- Walking distance to community pool- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $60 per day.- Surrounded by natural green space and parks- 5 adult bikes - Parking for 3 vehicles- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Experience the best of 30A at Beachy Blessings. This beautiful WaterColor Main House and Carriage House collectively accommodate 12 guests with 5 bedrooms, 5.5 bathrooms, a private pool, and multiple furnished porches. Only a 3-minute walk from Camp WaterColor’s pool and lazy river—and a 5-minute bike ride from the WaterColor Beach Club—this home promises carefree days of poolside fun and beach adventures!Inviting rocking chairs and soft seating greet guests on the Main House’s spacious front porch. Continue inside to find gleaming hardwood floors leading into a bright, open great room with luxe coffered ceilings. Meals are easy with the chef’s kitchen featuring a Wolf stove, SubZero refrigerator, island that seats 5, and a nearby dining table for 8. When it’s time to relax, the living space—with 4 armchairs, a plush sofa, and a 75” Smart TV—is perfect for watching movies or catching up with loved ones. A screened-in back porch with a 6-seat table and woven patio furniture leads to the secluded backyard with a private pool. Soak up rays on the loungers and sun shelf, or barbecue in the outdoor kitchen complete with bar seating. To the side are a ping-pong table, an outdoor shower, and an alfresco dining area for 10. At nightfall, light the firepit for gooey s’mores and campfire stories. This level hosts 1 guest bedroom with a king bed—all the property’s bedrooms feature a private bathroom.On the second level are 1 primary and 1 guest bedroom, each boasting a king bed and charming balcony with a swinging bench for peaceful unwinding. There’s also a kid-friendly bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds and an adjacent desk nook.The private Carriage House is ideal for couples, with a living area, kitchenette, Smart TV, balcony bistro set, and a guest bedroom with a king bed.Get away for a blissful WaterColor vacation at Beachy Blessings. Parking for 3 vehicles and 5 complimentary adult bikes makes exploring effortless. Guests can use 2 beach access points—the first is at the WaterColor Beach Club, and the second is on Goldenrod Circle, past the WaterColor Inn. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate-Bunkroom: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyCARRIAGE HOUSE:SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*The garage is not for guest use.
